courses.title: Intermediate French
courses.description: [GE 3B] Consolidation of previously learned grammar; introduction to new grammatical concepts and expansion of vocabulary. Practice in speaking French with attention to comprehension and oral expression.
courses.prerequisites: Instructor consent, FL 103, FRE 1112 , or equivalent.

courses.title: Intermediate French Reading
courses.description: [GE 3B] Development of reading comprehension while also working on other aspects of linguistic and cultural proficiency. Introduction to a variety of texts from France and the Francophone world.
courses.prerequisites: Instructor consent, FL 103, FRE 1112 , or equivalent.

courses.title: Intermediate French Composition and Conversation
courses.description: French composition, both oral and written. Frequent original presentations.
courses.prerequisites: Instructor consent, FL 103, FRE 1112 , or equivalent.

courses.title: Readings in French and Francophone Literature
courses.description: Literature of France and French-speaking world. Canonical authors such as Ronsard, Molire, Voltaire, Hugo, Baudelaire, Sartre, Duras, and representatives from the French-speaking world such as B, Senghor, Csaire, Dadi, Djebar, and Hbert.
courses.prerequisites: Instructor consent, FL 202, FRE 2111 , FRE 2112 , FRE 2113 , or equivalent.

courses.title: French Civilization
courses.description: Survey of French culture and social customs from the Gauls to De Gaulle. Conducted in French.
courses.prerequisites: Instructor consent, FL 202, FRE 2111 , FRE 2112 , FRE 2113 , or equivalent.

courses.title: Contemporary France
courses.description: Culture of 20th-century France, including art, music, history, literature, social customs, and the systems of government and education. Conducted in French.
courses.prerequisites: Instructor consent, FL 202, FRE 2111 , FRE 2112 , FRE 2113 , or equivalent.
